name: klik
description: Lets Claude see your Klik screenshots and pass work between sessions through a local inbox. No copy-paste.
long_description: Klik is a simple screenshot tool for Windows. This extension lets Claude read your latest screenshots, and gives every Claude session a shared handoff inbox on your PC, so a result from one session can be picked up by the next without copy-paste. Everything stays on your PC: screenshots are read from Pictures\Klik, and handoffs are plain Markdown files in Documents\Klik\Inbox.
